title: release.yml OIDC publish job runs scripts/readme-readback.sh with no checkout, so its last step can never run
description: Found by the LCLI-613 implementer (2026-09-27) and filed on opum-agent instruction before release so it cannot be lost to a session recycle. On origin/dev, .github/workflows/release.yml publish job (the OIDC trusted-publishing path) has only download-artifact and setup-node as uses:, and no actions/checkout. Yet its last step runs `bash scripts/readme-readback.sh`, which cannot exist in that job workspace, so the step would fail on any OIDC publish. lore currently publishes through scripts/publish-release.sh (the manual path; OIDC is broken per LCLI-482), which is why this has never surfaced. LCLI-613 adds a sparse checkout (package.json and the parity checker only, persist-credentials false) that still omits the read-back script. A second issue: with Article 3.5 staging under release-candidate, the README read-back belongs after the latest move, not after publish, since npm serves the latest publish README.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The OIDC publish job either checks out scripts/readme-readback.sh (sparse, credential-less) or the read-back moves to where latest moves; a test over release.yml pins that every script a job runs is present in that job checkout
The README read-back runs after the latest move for a staged release, and the runbook says so
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers the release.yml change
